Apple___Apple_scab.note: Apply at bud burst and after rain events in spring.

Apple___Black_rot.note: Prune infected wood before applying any fungicide.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.note: Apply at pink bud stage and repeat after rain.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.note: Start applications when first symptoms appear.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.note: Apply at first sign of lesions, especially in humid conditions.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.note: Scout regularly; apply fungicide if more than 50% of plants are affected.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.note: Apply at VT/R1 growth stage for best protection.

Grape___Black_rot.note: Apply from bud swell through fruit set.

recommended_products: No chemical cure available — focus on wound protection
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).note: Use wound sealants after pruning. Consult your agriculture officer.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.note: Apply during humid periods and after rain.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).note: No cure exists for HLB. Focus on psyllid control and removing infected trees.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.note: Apply copper sprays from pink bud stage; avoid during bloom.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.note: Use disease-free seed and apply copper sprays during wet weather.

Potato___Early_blight.note: Start applications before disease onset; repeat every 7-10 days.

Potato___Late_blight.note: Act fast — late blight spreads rapidly. Contact your agriculture officer immediately.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.note: Apply at first sign of white powder on leaves.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.note: Remove infected leaves before applying fungicide.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.note: Apply copper sprays at first sign; avoid during hot humid weather.

Tomato___Early_blight.note: Remove infected lower leaves and apply fungicide from early season.

Tomato___Late_blight.note: Act immediately — late blight spreads fast. Consult your agriculture officer.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.note: Improve ventilation first, then apply fungicide if needed.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.note: Remove infected lower leaves; apply fungicide preventively in wet seasons.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.note: Rotate miticide classes to prevent resistance. Consult your agriculture officer.

Tomato___Target_Spot.note: Apply at first sign of symptoms; repeat every 10-14 days.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.note: No cure for the virus — control whitefly vectors. Remove infected plants.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.note: Wash hands and tools; remove infected plants immediately.
